title: Photoemission from Ordered Stripe Phases
abstract: A phase separation model for stripes has found good agreement with photoemission experiments and with other studies which suggest a termination of the striped phase in the slightly overdoped regime. Here the model is extended in a number of respects. In particular, a discussion of the nature of the charged stripes is presented, suggesting how density waves, superconductivity, and strong correlations can compete with the quantum size effects inherent in narrow stripes. The anomalous doping dependence of the chemical potential is explained.
